mascotDesc.zh: 站在窗口右下角的伙伴，随任务状态换动作；按住可拖到别处。
mascotDesc.en: The companion in the window's bottom-right corner; it acts out what the agent is doing. Drag it to move it.

mascotPictureDesc.zh: 默认使用内置长征姬立绘；也可以上传你有权使用的角色图（PNG、WebP、GIF、SVG 或 JPG，不超过 8 MB，透明背景最佳）。
mascotPictureDesc.en: The included Long March portrait is used by default. You can upload a picture you may use (PNG, WebP, GIF, SVG or JPG, up to 8 MB; a transparent background works best).

mascotPictureType.zh: 只接受 PNG、WebP、GIF、SVG 或 JPG 图片。
mascotPictureType.en: Only PNG, WebP, GIF, SVG or JPG images are accepted.

mascotPictureSize.en: The image is larger than 8 MB.
